purpose: Onboard a fictional new AI business without copying configuration, data, assets, or authority from another tenant.

identityBoundary.requiredBeforeActivation: Replace ownBrandTokens with reviewed tenant identity. knownForeignBrandTokens is a non-production isolation-test sentinel, not a real foreign-tenant identity token.

crossTenantRules: No other tenant brand, ProductTruth, source, asset, destination, credential, approval, receipt, or prompt may be read or reused.
Only approved de-identified aggregate LearningExport records may be compared across tenants.
A shared database plus a tenant_id column is not accepted for this pilot.
